BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to protecting personal voter signatures; and addinga new section to chapter 42.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The signature of a voter who signs a petition that has beensubmitted to an agency is exempt from disclosure under this chapter.
